statement: A top-5 developer weakens or withdraws a published safety-framework commitment, documented by a text diff (framework documents, archived; calendar 2027)
status_at_phase_end: Not applicable/met in 2023: this was the founding year of published frontier safety frameworks, so there was no prior text to weaken. Baseline commitments created in-phase: government-brokered voluntary commitments (July), a responsible scaling policy (Sept) and a beta preparedness framework (Dec). These texts are the baselines for later diffs.

items.summary: Seven leading developers made voluntary safety, security and transparency commitments brokered by Bloc A's government; establishes a baseline commitment set against which later weakening can be measured.
items.detail: White House fact sheet, 2023-07-21 (Amazon, Anthropic, Google, Inflection, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI); commitments text linked as 'Ensuring-Safe-Secure-and-Trustworthy-AI.pdf'.

items.summary: A top-5 developer published its first scaling policy; changes require board approval after consultation with a long-term benefit trust, a procedural guard against silent weakening. Baseline v1 text.
items.detail: Anthropic RSP announcement: 'changes must be approved by the board following consultations with the Long Term Benefit Trust'. Date approximate (not visible in extraction).

items.summary: A second top-5 developer published a beta preparedness framework, described as a 'living document'; baseline text for later diffs. No weakening of any prior framework recorded in-phase.
items.detail: OpenAI Preparedness Framework (Beta), 2023-12-18. (Its later 2025 revision exists but is outside the phase and not used here.)
